verdict.rationale: All choices satisfy the stated meeting-day constraints, but none is clearly dominant without an unstated value judgment. A buys more post-call time and an earlier arrival home than B for $8 more; B is cheaper and arrives in New York earlier. D is cheaper than A while sacrificing roughly an hour at each end of the trip. C is the lowest-priced option and arrives in New York about as early as D, but adds a connection and a later final arrival home. The query supplies no policy or preference for fare savings, schedule convenience, nonstop service, or time at the destination.
